label: Bright stars
description: A curated set of familiar, intrinsically bright stellar landmarks within 1000 light-years, plus the Sun.

sources.name: SIMBAD TAP snapshot; named-star identity, astrometry, classification, compiled Johnson V and radial velocity
SIMBAD bibliographic parameter and diameter measurements; mesFe_h and mesDiameter ranked rows
Allende Prieto & Lambert (1999); Hipparcos model masses, radii and temperatures
McDonald et al. (2012); Hipparcos SED temperatures and luminosities
Ohnaka et al. (2013); Antares A mass and age range
Tango et al. (2006); Shaula A component mass
Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed.; combined visual magnitude for Acrux

cutoffPolicy: Curated recognizable landmarks from the visually brightest named stars: distance no greater than 1000 light-years and absolute visual magnitude approximately +2 or brighter. Altair at +2.21 is retained as a boundary landmark. This is intentionally representative, not a complete magnitude-limited census.
snapshot: J2000.0; SIMBAD TAP queried 2026-09-25; physical sources frozen 2026-09-25; 36 named landmarks plus Sirius A and Sun.
